measurements.name: specimen_foreground_fraction
measurements.source: museum-background heuristic; 0.55 is a prior, not the measurement
measurements.note: non-circular: measured area fraction differs from the prior

measurements.name: specimen_contour_circularity
measurements.source: a circle would score 1; three shells on white do not

measurements.name: specimen_structure_tensor_coherency
measurements.method: mean (λ1-λ2)/(λ1+λ2) of the Sobel structure tensor
measurements.source: composite coherency is the reference column; specimen value is measured separately

measurements.name: pde_versus_target_wavelength_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r of 6 target wavelengths vs PDE radial-FFT peaks after fastest-mode calibration
measurements.source: gate is r>0.98; the value is the measured correlation

measurements.name: calibrated_wavelength_nm
measurements.method: dominant radial-FFT wavelength of the 2.0 nm Schnakenberg run
measurements.source: slot assignment 2.0 nm; Pass 1 uncalibrated PDE peak was 2.52 nm

measurements.name: equal_diffusion_ablation_ratio
measurements.method: std(u | D_u=D_v) / std(u | D_v=36 D_u) at the calibrated 2.0 nm scale
measurements.source: a ratio of 1 would mean the control still patterns
measurements.note: negative control; trace f_u+g_v < 0 so equal diffusion is linearly stable
